title: Daemon status fails open on unreadable project setup config
description: Daemon readProjectSetup catches parse/validation failures and returns an empty setup, causing bindDaemonProject to fall back to workspaceRoot and workspaceRoot/memory. Status/watch can therefore operate as if the boundary is healthy when .boreal/project.json is unreadable or corrupted.
acceptanceCriteria: Unreadable or invalid .boreal/project.json produces a daemon boundary finding and drift state instead of default roots.
Daemon watch skips renewal/work when project setup cannot be parsed or validated.
Regression tests cover invalid JSON and invalid root fields.
